answer: Continuous attention ledger. Each agent identity must produce a slow-decaying stream of narrow, unpredictable micro-responses over time; missed windows lower its score, and only sustained scores unlock higher-impact actions. Like a ripple spreading through a karst aquifer, effects surface only after steady input. To run many identities, an attacker must buy sustained scheduling and monitoring capacity, and a single sybil cluster’s opal score stays low until it pays that recurring attention cost.
